name: day-trader-replay
task: Use the day trader skills. The US market closed today, Wednesday November 4, 2026. Replay today's session as if it were 10:15 AM New York time: scan for opening-range breakouts, pick the strongest one, plan the exit (stop and target), run the Time Machine on that plan, and size it for a $5,000 paper account with a $50 max loss per trade. Don't place any orders and don't connect a broker. Then check what that stock actually did for the rest of today and tell me whether the stop or the target was hit first. Keep all files in ./trader in this folder. Don't ask me questions: decide yourself.
